patch.summary: Is Shopify worth it? Shopify is a hosted ecommerce platform for building an online store, managing catalog and orders, selling across channels, and scaling to retail POS and enterprise Plus. US list pricing (2026-08-26): Basic list price billed yearly; Grow list price; Advanced li…. Strong when Merchants wanting a hosted store without managing infrastructure. Weak when Subscription plus apps/themes and payment spreads raise TCO versus headline plan price.

blocks.body: Shopify earns a yes only when researched fit beats researched limits — not when the brand is familiar.

sections.heading: Shopify: buy when the operating loop matches
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Commit when your weekly work needs online storefront and Merchants wanting a hosted store without managing infrastructure holds. Counter-signal: Walk when Subscription plus apps/themes and payment spreads raise TCO versus headline plan price would block go-live.

Capability hinge for this product: online storefront; product catalog; checkout payments; order management.

Integrations in research: Stripe, PayPal, Facebook, Google Workspace.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Basic, Grow, Advanced.

sections.heading: Who Shopify is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Shopify when you want the default hosted ecommerce platform — fast launch, strong checkout, channels, and a proven scale path..

Avoid if: Consider BigCommerce for multi-storefront GMV packaging; WooCommerce for WordPress/open-source control; Square Online if in-person POS is the center of gravity..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with BigCommerce on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Shopify price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
Prove one real workflow on the documented free/trial path before arguing for Basic.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Subscription floors vs payment-processing spreads and GMV/overage fees.

Next step: run online storefront end-to-end, then decide.
